commands: psql "$DB" -c "UPDATE \"PaymentInstallment\" SET status = 'PAID', \"paidAt\" = NOW(), notes = 'PIX confirmado manualmente — cliente declarou pagamento em 26/04/2026' FROM \"OrderFinancial\" f WHERE \"PaymentInstallment\".\"financialId\" = f.id AND f.\"orderId\" = 'cmog5rlj20000r9nqmfwo0zdy' AND \"PaymentInstallment\".status = 'PENDING' RETURNING \"PaymentInstallment\".id, \"PaymentInstallment\".\"amountCents\", \"PaymentInstallment\".status;"

psql "$DB" -c "UPDATE \"OrderFinancial\" SET status = 'PAID', \"paidCents\" = \"totalAmountCents\", \"updatedAt\" = NOW() WHERE \"orderId\" = 'cmog5rlj20000r9nqmfwo0zdy' RETURNING id, status, \"paidCents\", \"totalAmountCents\";"
